text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. At my own pace,
and at the exact timing Trainer taught me...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Right here...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
This! This is it~!
This is... our true way of running——!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright! Go, right there!
(WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

Mejiro Bright, who used to lament that she had
never brought anything to the Mejiro family—

On this day, upon the GⅠ stage,
she firmly engraved her own Mejiro hoofprints.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I have returned~
Trainer, Dober~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back, Bright. That was a good run.
...Though the start was a bit slow.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Indeed~. Trainer, I must apologize~. As usual, my start from the gate wasn't quite ideal~.
choice_data_list: Still, you managed to turn things around.
Still, you managed to turn things around.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes~. Because I was taught where I should begin my spurt from~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I can always hear it, you know~
Your voice, Trainer.

After hearing the go-sign given over and over again during training,
it must have started echoing in her mind subconsciously.

"In this race, Mejiro Bright proved that
the racing style the two of them developed
was fully viable even in GⅠ races."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you very much for letting me
run in the Hopeful Stakes~.
It was quite a challenge, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, the path has opened up for me~
Right on schedule.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Right on schedule, huh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"There will be another GⅠ race next year
under the same conditions as today... Nakayama 2000m, right~?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Even for someone as easygoing as me, running the course once helps me feel at ease~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Nakayama 2000m... That's the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So Bright, keeping that first and foremost in mind,
this rotation is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Was that your Trainer's instructions after all?
As a Trainer, I was naturally aware of it. But I never thought Mejiro Bright was this keenly aware of it herself.

Though her pace is gentle, Mejiro Bright
clearly sees the path leading
to the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Now, Dober, the real show begins here.
For you, the Triple Tiara.
For me, the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Let us both do our best.
For the sake of our beloved Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right, Bright.
I promise.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this, the two of us! We'll bring a Classic crown
back to the Mejiro family for the first time in ages!
Ever since Mejiro McQueen won the Kikuka Sho, no Mejiro Umamusume had claimed a Classic GⅠ title.

The golden seasonal wind blows once more after so long.
Carrying the hopes of the Mejiro family, Mejiro Bright sets her sights on the Satsuki Sho.
